Safe metadata:
`{details}`

The first line is the normal sanitized MFA challenge. The second line, when present, contains several bounded continuation hypotheses tested automatically in the same run. No OTP, email code or backup code was submitted. Copy only these safe metadata lines; do not post screenshots containing your email address or any raw VeSync response.
result.title: VeSync authentication probe result

data_description.api_region: Use EU for accounts handled by the European VeSync service. Use GLOBAL for the US and other non-EU regions.
data_description.country_code: Two-letter ISO country code for the VeSync account, for example HU, DE, GB or US.
data_description.password: Used only inside this one diagnostic run. It is not stored by the probe.
data_description.username: Email address used by the VeSync account. It is not stored by the probe.

user.description: This diagnostic tool runs beside Home Assistant's built-in VeSync integration. It performs the verified first-stage sign-in request. If VeSync returns an MFA challenge that advertises otp, the probe then tests a small no-code continuation ladder automatically in the same run. The ladder varies one request shape at a time, never submits a second-factor code, stops on rate limiting/account lock, and never creates entities or changes the built-in VeSync integration.
user.title: Probe VeSync 2FA authentication
